summary.title: Executive Summary — The Week in Numbers

blocks.label: The week in one line
blocks.text: Nifty 50 -2.09% · FPI equity -₹5,695 Cr · USD/INR 95.69 · Brent +8.65% · breadth mixed.
FPIs: a net equity outflow of ₹5,695 Cr across 5 NSDL reporting days (2 of 5 positive); debt -₹1,885 Cr.
Nifty 50 -2.09% to 23,398.10, Midcap 150 -1.38%, Smallcap 250 -0.77% in the week to 11 Sep.
Of 1,555 coded names in the scan, 541 rose and 1,007 fell on the week (median -1.42%). Breadth regime: **mixed**, with 47.3% above the 50-DMA and 57.5% above the 200-DMA.
Stage 2 by calculation (all 7 template checks): 380 names, 109 entered and 115 left since 27 Aug. The provider's Stage 2 list (701 names) was updated this week.

SwingEdge sub-sector trackers: 15 of 32 trackers rose. Led by Dyes & Pigments (H-acid, K-acid) (+18.62%), API & Bulk Drugs (+10.76%), Optical Fibre & Telecom Gear (+8.99%); lagged by CNC Machines (-6.44%), Sugar & Ethanol (-6.08%), Semiconductors & Chip Design (-5.77%). The equal-weight market line: -0.06%.

blocks.label: How this report is built
blocks.text: Built automatically by `tools/auto_weekly.py` from data the evening pull already has: the screener.in scan, NSE's index file, NSDL's FPI Monitor, RBI's current rates, Yahoo closes, and SwingEdge's own breadth, Stage 2 and tracker files. No model writes any of it: each sentence is a template filled with the week's numbers. Not collected: DII daily flows and derivatives positioning (no keyless source). Facts only; nothing here rates a stock.
